domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, manager decision, and potential cancellation.

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequestStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of all possible lifecycle states for a LeaveRequest. Governs which transitions are valid.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Catalog of leave categories (annual, sick, emergency, etc.). Each LeaveRequest references one LeaveType. The isActive flag controls whether the type is available for new requests.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules governing a specific leave type: how many days are entitled, whether manager approval is required, minimum notice periods, and accrual caps. Referenced by LeaveBalance to compute remaining days.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific leave type within a fiscal year. Updated atomically when leave is approved or cancelled.

business_rules: LR-TRANSITION-01: A LeaveRequest in DRAFT state may transition to SUBMITTED (by the owning employee) or CANCELLED (by the owning employee). No other transitions are valid from DRAFT.

LR-TRANSITION-02: A LeaveRequest in SUBMITTED state may transition to APPROVED (by a manager), REJECTED (by a manager), or CANCELLED (by the owning employee). No other transitions are valid from SUBMITTED.
LR-TRANSITION-03: A LeaveRequest in APPROVED state may transition to CANCELLED (by the owning employee). It may NOT transition back to SUBMITTED, DRAFT, or REJECTED.
LR-TRANSITION-04: A LeaveRequest in REJECTED state may transition to DRAFT (by the owning employee, to revise and resubmit) or CANCELLED. It may NOT transition directly to APPROVED.
LR-TRANSITION-05: A LeaveRequest in CANCELLED state is terminal. No further transitions are permitted.
LR-APPROVAL-01: Only an employee designated as the requesting employee's manager (Employee.managerId matches the approver's id) may approve or reject a LeaveRequest. Self-approval is prohibited.
LR-APPROVAL-02: When a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, the approvedBy field must be set to the approving manager's employee id and approvedAt must be set to the current timestamp.
